name: Trim Stain Prep — Template (LF)
intent: Canonical bare-wood stain prep for LF trim substrates — sand bare wood, fill defects (larger), fill (smaller / nail holes), dust wipe, conditioner on softwood. Extended by per-substrate MOD_PREP_<substrate>_STAIN modules (baseboard / crown / chair rail / panel mold / picture rail / shadow box / shoe mold / window apron / window casing / window jamb / window stool / door casing / door frame).
doctrine: Stain prep template — bare wood sequence parallel to paint-side MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_PAINT but pre-primer (stain skips primer). WOOD_PUTTY (defects) + WOOD_PUTTY_FILL (small fills like nail holes) mirror SPACKLE_DEFECT + TOUCHUP_FILL on the paint side. Conditioner is apply+wipe combined via TSK_CONDITIONER_LF (one task, softwood-gated). Default height:false matches current per-substrate convention; individual modules override for tall-trim substrates (crown, picture rail, etc.) if desired.
